title: Sovereigns of the Dark
synopsis: Open war breaks out between the autocratic Archon Dominion and the united corsair flotillas. In a devastating ambush, Astrid's flagship is crippled and she is captured by Commodore Hawke. Refusing to lose the woman he loves, Leo takes command of an archaic heavy strike craft and mounts an impossible high-g rescue mission into the heart of the Dominion's orbital fortress.

chapters.title: The Gateway Transit
chapters.summary: The violent spacetime transition through the jump ring; emerging on the doorstep of the Core Systems.

chapters.title: The Dominions Iron Grip
chapters.summary: Witnessing the heavily militarized Dominion fortress world of Kaelus-Prime.

chapters.title: Scavenger Infiltration
chapters.summary: Disguising the Marauder as an ore transport to slip past orbital security nets.

chapters.title: The Ambush at Gate Three
chapters.summary: Commodore Hawke was waiting; automated tractor nets and EMP minefields ensnare the Marauder.

chapters.title: The Last Stand on the Bridge
chapters.summary: Astrid orders the crew into the escape lifepods while she holds the bridge controls.

chapters.title: Captured
chapters.summary: Astrid is taken prisoner by Hawke; the Marauder is boarded and stripped.

chapters.title: The Pilot in the Shadows
chapters.summary: Leo, hiding in a hidden crawlspace with Orlo, evades capture as the ship is towed to the prison station.

chapters.title: The Iron Spire
chapters.summary: Astrid faces interrogation by Hawke, refusing to disclose the coordinates of the Sol beacon.

chapters.title: Planning the Impossible
chapters.summary: Leo and Orlo recruit rogue dockworkers and imprisoned smugglers on the station.

chapters.title: Stealing a Relic
chapters.summary: Leo infiltrates the imperial impound bay and hot-wires an experimental heavy strike fighter.

chapters.title: Blackout at Sector 7
chapters.summary: Orlo detonates an EMP charge in the station's primary cooling conduit; emergency lights only.

chapters.title: Gunfight on the Gantry
chapters.summary: Leo fights through Dominion storm-troopers, armed with a high-velocity rail carbine.

chapters.title: Breaching the High Security Block
chapters.summary: Leo blows the cell doors; reunited with Astrid in an emotional, breathless embrace.

chapters.title: No Time for Tears
chapters.summary: Fighting their way back to the strike craft under heavy fire from gun emplacements.

chapters.title: The Launch Bay Ejection
chapters.summary: Launching out of the depressurizing hangar bay into a sea of patrolling gunboats.

chapters.title: Atmospheric Skim
chapters.summary: Leo pilots the craft into the upper atmosphere of Kaelus to shake missile locks.

chapters.title: The Reunion on the Corsair Flagship
chapters.summary: Meeting up with the regrouped pirate fleet; Astrid takes command of the allied armada.

chapters.title: Declaration of War
chapters.summary: Astrid broadcasts a call to arms across all free systems: the march on Sol begins.

chapters.title: The Fleet Gathers
chapters.summary: Hundreds of modified corvettes, mining rigs, and corsair cruisers form up in the void.

chapters.title: Jump to Sol
chapters.summary: The allied armada initiates the coordinated burn toward humanity's quarantined origin.
